note: DigitalPrez's working crosswalk from NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 controls to the clauses of other frameworks, used by scripts/coverage.mjs to answer which controls of a model touch which clause. It is a working aid written by DigitalPrez, LLC, not an official mapping by any of the publishers: a control listed under a clause contributes to it, it does not by itself satisfy it. Clause numbers and the short titles beside them are given for navigation; the standards themselves are the publishers'. The CIS Controls are deliberately absent because their licence does not permit redistribution in a commercially licensed product. A model can extend or override this file with a frameworks.json of the same shape beside it (merged by control id and by clause); an organisation that holds the publishers' own mapping tables puts them there. NIST SP 800-171 Rev. 2 entries follow NIST's own Appendix D mapping of each requirement to SP 800-53 controls, with the Rev. 4 identifiers that Rev. 5 withdrew carried to their Rev. 5 successors (AU-2(3) to AU-2, AU-8(1) to SC-45(1), IA-2(3) to IA-2(1), IA-2(9) to IA-2(8), MP-5(4) to SC-28(1), MP-7(1) to MP-7) and SC-19 dropped, so requirement 3.13.14 is reached only by direct citation. CMMC 2.0 entries carry the Level 2 identifiers, the requirement number behind its family (AC.L2-3.1.1), and the Level 1 identifiers with the requirements Table 2 to 32 CFR 170.15(c)(1)(ii) maps them to; Level 3 (SP 800-172) is not included.
